title: Mixed-universe localization factorization of an ordinary affine chart unit equation
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism between affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with independent module and sheaf derived localization universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Write $F_S$ for termwise tilde followed by restriction along the canonical spectrum chart [lem-weil-pbc-affine-tilde-gamma-adjunction], $H=\Gamma_S$, $J=\Gamma_T$ for ordinary global sections [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], $E$ for ordinary extension along $g.appTop$, $R$ for restriction, and $K$ for fixed tensor pullback [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $c:F_S H E\to F_S K J$ be a natural transformation with the ordinary unit equation $\eta_E(H(F_S(N)))\,R(c_N)=H(\eta_K(F_S(N)))$ for every module $N$. No invertibility of $c$ is assumed. The displayed additive instances only spell termwise complex functors. For a K-flat module cochain complex $P$ [def-pc-module-kflat-complex], put $Q=Q(F_S(P))$. There exist isomorphisms $a:\mathrm{mixedGlobalExtension}_g(R\Gamma_S Q)\cong Q((F_SHE)(P))$ [lem-sc-mixed-global-extension-adjunction] and $b:R\Gamma_T(Lg^*Q)\cong Q((F_SKJ)(P))$ [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction] such that $n\,b=a\,Q(c_P)$, where $n$ is the scalar-extension transpose of $R\Gamma_S(\eta_g(Q))$ followed by the fixed normalized mixed Leray comparison [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso]. No boundedness, flatness of g, or equality of derived universes is required. The endpoints and full factorization are recorded verbatim in lean.statement.

proof.text: Put C=F_S(P), X=H(C), and Y=K(C). The invertible ordinary affine chart tilde unit identifies X with P as complexes, so X is K-flat. Tilde of P is K-flat; transport through the exact chart restriction equivalence to get K-flatness of C. The extension left-derived counit on X and the pullback left-derived counit on C are therefore invertible. For the latter, the K-flat chart comparison computes the pullback on this precise chart model, without any arbitrary representative choice.

The ordinary-to-derived sections units are invertible on C and Y. Transport the proved affineTildeDerivedSectionsUnit_isIso comparison along the spectrum charts. For Y, use the termwise tensorPullback/tilde comparison along Spec.map g.appTop, together with toSpecGamma_naturality and the restriction-composition isomorphisms, to identify Y with the chart tilde of E(P). Thus the same affine comparison applies. Write s_S:Q(X) to RGamma_S(Q(C)) and s_T:Q(J(Y)) to RGamma_T(Q(Y)) for the invertible sections comparisons, with their quotient/homotopy identifications. Identify the fixed mixed extension adjunction with the standard derived extension/restriction adjunction by left-adjoint uniqueness, preserving the unit. Define a as the inverse of derived extension applied to s_S, followed by its K-flat counit on X and the quotient/homotopy identifications. Define b as RGamma_T of the K-flat pullback counit on C, followed by s_T inverse. These give precisely the displayed endpoints in the independent module localization universe.

Apply hc termwise and then map to the homotopy categories and module localization. The derived adjunction unit factorization derivedη_fac_app expresses each derived unit in terms of the ordinary homotopy unit, its left-derived counit, and its right-derived unit. The pinned scheme pullback adjunction satisfies this equation by exists_schemeDerivedAdjunction; the extension uniqueness isomorphism in a preserves its unit. Substitute these factorizations into the localized hc equality. Naturality moves the right-derived sections units through the left-derived counits. The derived-unit equation for mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso replaces the localized identity on direct-image sections by its fixed normalized mixed Leray lift. Cancel the invertible s_S,s_T and the K-flat counits and apply the adjunction hom-equivalence equation; the result is n b.hom = a.hom Q(c_P). Localization of sheaves and of modules occurs separately. This argument uses hc only and never the invertibility of c. Explicitly, suppress the quotient/homotopy factor isomorphisms and write q for localization, s_C:q(HC) -> RGamma_S(qC), s_Y:q(JY) -> RGamma_T(qY), e_E:LE(qX) -> q(EX), e_K:Lg*(qC) -> qY and r_Z:q(RZ) -> R(qZ). The extension equation is eta_LE(qX) R(e_E) = q(eta_E(X)) r_EX. The pullback equation is eta_Lg(qC) Rg_*(e_K) = q(eta_K(C)) u_DI(Y). Naturality of the sections unit gives s_C RGamma_S(q eta_K(C)) = q(H eta_K(C)) s_DI(Y). Normalized Leray gives s_DI(Y) RGamma_S(u_DI(Y)) Leray(qY) = r_JY R(s_Y). Naturality of Leray at e_K then identifies the Hom-equivalent of LE(s_C) n b.hom with q(H eta_K(C)) r_JY. Localizing hc and using naturality of r at c_P makes this q(eta_E(X)) r_EX R(q(c_P)). The extension unit equation turns it into the Hom-equivalent of e_E q(c_P). Injectivity of the Hom equivalence therefore gives LE(s_C) n b.hom = e_E q(c_P). Cancel the invertible LE(s_C) and substitute a.hom = LE(s_C) inverse followed by e_E to obtain the stated factorization. The comparison isomorphisms between q on complexes and Qh on their homotopy quotient are inserted at every endpoint; their naturality yields exactly the displayed Lean equality.

theorem exists_mixedAffineSections_chart_model_factorization
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ (R : Type u) [Ring R], HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (ModuleCat.{u} R)]
    {S T : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine S] [IsAffine T] (g : T ⟶ S) :
    let F : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) :=
      tilde.functor Γ(S, ⊤) ⋙ Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor S.toSpecΓ
    let H := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor S.toRingedSpace
    let J := RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor T.toRingedSpace
    let E := ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, u, u} g.appTop.hom
    let K : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings S.toRingedSpace) ⥤
        SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace) := Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g
    ∀ (c : F ⋙ H ⋙ E ⟶ F ⋙ K ⋙ J),
      (∀ N : ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤),
        (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj g.appTop.hom).unit.app (H.obj (F.obj N)) ≫
          (ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{u} g.appTop.hom).map (c.app N) =
        H.map ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).unit.app
          (F.obj N))) →
      ∀ [F.Additive] [H.Additive] [J.Additive] [E.Additive] [K.Additive]
        (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) ℤ)
        (_hP : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(S, ⊤)) (.up ℤ)).kFlat P),
      let Q := DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
      ∃ (a : (mixedGlobalExtension g).obj ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).obj Q) ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((F ⋙ H ⋙ E).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
        (b : (schemeDerivedGlobalSections T).obj ((derivedPullback g).obj Q) ≅
            DerivedCategory.Q.obj (((F ⋙ K ⋙ J).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)),
        (((mixedGlobalExtensionAdjunction g).homEquiv _ _).symm
          ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections S).map ((schemeHomPullbackAdjunction g).unit.app Q) ≫
            (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app ((derivedPullback g).obj Q))) ≫
              b.hom = a.hom ≫
                DerivedCategory.Q.map ((c.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).app P)
